title: Relaxing Mandalas Bold & Easy Coloring Book
subtitle: 50 Big, Bold Geometric & Floral Mandalas for Kids, Teens & Adults (Easy to Intricate)
author: Crayon Cove Press
description_html:
50 crisp, symmetrical mandalas for calm, creative coloring!

Whether you are 8 or 80, these bold geometric and floral mandalas are designed for effortless, screen-free relaxation.

  • 50 unique symmetrical mandalas progressing from easy to intricate
  • Single-sided pages (blank backs to help prevent marker bleed-through)
  • Thick, clean outlines — great for markers, gel pens, pencils or crayons
  • Large 8.5 x 11 inch format

A thoughtful gift for kids, teens, and adults who love patterns, mindfulness, and creative quiet time.
